provenance.construction: Two-block group-algebra CSS code over Aff(F_19) = C_19 semidirect C_18 with action r=2, using H_X=[L(a)|R(b)] and H_Z=[R(b)^T|L(a)^T]. Element index is (x exponent)*18+(y exponent), with a=[182,323,322,217] and b=[176,208,142,68].
provenance.notes: Equivalence review: checked against the current board entries and their published construction data; not equivalent to an existing entry. The selected code was screened in a 3,500-candidate affine support-mutation run and then re-verified with independent RIS passes at 100,000 trials (pair depth 24), 1,000,000 trials (pair depths 32 and 48), and 2,000,000 trials (pair depths 48 and 64). The deepest X witness has weight 78 and the deepest Z witness has weight 77; both pass the opposite-kernel and non-stabilizer checks.
